 'posterior_variance':posterior_variance,
 'median_agenda_no_bias_final_by_authority_weight':{str(w): w*median+(1-w)*median for w in (.3,.1)},
 'median_plus_10bps_final_by_authority_weight':{str(w):w*(median+.1)+(1-w)*median for w in (.3,.1)},
 'six_yes_of_12_formula_accepts':6/12>=.5,
